scope: Refresh 'pa38_40' of OCR v2 (templates from PAs [1, 2, 9, 18]) by scripts/70_refresh_ocr_reports.py: predictions, held-out score, negatives and a repeat check regenerated after the eval set changed. Code and template equality with the reference commit is recorded in code_and_templates.

git_reference.meaning: Commit whose predictions count as previous and whose code/templates the lf-normalized equality flags are computed against.

preregistration.rule: (1) keep v1 source PAs 1, 2, 9; (2) candidates = eval-set entries with labels.inning == 3, readability == 'readable', all ten field_status 'confirmed', cached frame passes bug_present (navy >= 0.3, top_line >= 0.6, panel_white <= 0.2), and each of the five DIGIT_FIELDS segments into as many glyphs as the label has digits; (3) keep only plate appearances with exactly one eval-set entry; (4) among those choose the one adding the fewest non-'0'/'3' glyphs, ties broken by earliest frame_seconds. PA 5/6 (balls=3) is never a source. Result: PA18/1 (t=1706.25).
preregistration.blindness: not 'frames unseen': the judge looked at bug crops of 9 candidate frames and computed only v1 gate values / glyph sizes; no glyph distances or v2 accuracy were computed before the rule was fixed. Report as 'rule fixed, then first-computed held-out'.

frame_cache.scope: Exact current JPEG bytes, not a full-video hash. Cache must be transferred separately.

git_reference.meaning: Code, thresholds, v1 templates and v1 outputs before v2 was built.

limitations: Same-game development evidence, not an independent benchmark.
Template-source PAs [1, 2, 9, 18] are excluded from held-out scoring; the template PA rule was fixed before any v2 prediction.
The digit-3 test fields are almost all the inning number of the 3rd inning; one balls=3 field (PA 5/6) tests another field.
Timing and labels come from direct selected-frame AI review; no independent human inter-rater measurement.
SNY 1280x720 layout only; not a general broadcast OCR.
